Healthcare is complex. We’re here to change that.
RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.
Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.
AT A GLANCE
RVO Health is looking to add a People Data Analyst to our Human Capital (HR) team. This is a mid-level role for someone with 1-3 years of experience who can not only extract insights, but also partner cross-functionally to influence strategic decisions and identify areas for the team to increase impact. You will help the Talent Analytics team continue to pursue our mission of driving value for RVO Health through our people.
What You’ll Do
Conduct advanced data analyses from Workforce planning to Compensation, to Performance and more.
Generate insights and a compelling story, and present to Talent Leadership Team and Executive Leadership Team members
Collaborate with Finance and Talent leadership to inform the organization about workforce planning and budgetary insights
Build analytical tools, such as self-service BI products and interactive dashboards, that visualize and analyze data.
Build reporting solutions – telling the right people the right information at the right time
What We’re Looking For
1-3 years of hands-on experience in data analytics, with an emphasis on workforce and talent insights.
Strong analytical skills with experience demonstrating an aptitude to compile data in comprehensive reports, analyze trends, and make fact-based recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize data into actionable insights and communicate recommendations to leadership
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working well with business stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to streamline and automate processes
Experience with visualization tools such as Quicksight, Tableau, QlikView, PowerBI, or Looker to build dynamic/scalable dashboards and reports.
Experience with employee engagement tools (e.g., Qualtrics, CultureAmp)
Fluency coding in one analytical programming knowledge (e.g., R or Python) and SQL is required
Knowledge or experience with people analytics is preferred
Team-oriented, success-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude.

**Overview**
**Who We Are**
We are a community built on care. Our caregivers and supporting staff extend compassion to those in need, helping to improve the health and well-being of those we serve, and provide comfort and healing. Your community is our community.
  
  
**Our Story**
We started out as a small operation in California. In May 1969, we acquired four hospitals, some additional care facilities and real estate for the future development of hospitals. Over the years, we've grown tremendously in size, scope and capability, building a home in new markets over time, and curating those homes to provide a compassionate environment for those entrusting us with their care.
  
  
We have a rich history at Tenet. There are so many stories of compassionate care; so many "firsts" in terms of medical innovation; so many examples of enhancing healthcare delivery and shaping a business that is truly centered around patients and community need. Tenet and our predecessors have enabled us to touch many different elements of healthcare and make a difference in the lives of others.
  
  
**Our Impact Today**
Today, we are leading health system and services platform that continues to evolve in lockstep with community need. Tenet's operations include three businesses - our hospitals and physicians, USPI and Conifer Health Solutions.
  
  
Our impact spreads far and deep with 65 hospitals and approximately 510 outpatient centers and additional sites of care. We are differentiated by our top notch medical specialists and service lines that are tailored within each community we serve. The work Conifer is doing will help provide the foundation for better health for clients across the country, through the delivery of healthcare-focused revenue cycle management and value-based care solutions.
  
  
Together as an enterprise, we work to save lives and can accept nothing less than excellence from ourselves in service of our patients and their families, every day.
